rows.procedure: Run the 30-minute round-two stress session of UA-F13 (levels opened, legs flown with double taps, ship drags and the panel, destinations chosen with taps and waits with the slider, actions undone and redone, the camera orbited, levels retried and replayed in a loop) at automatic levels; the campaign samples the footprint and the thermal state.

owner_steps: The owner has the device in hand, unlocked, trusted and charged; the automation build is installed by the campaign (signing is the owner's).

The owner taps stars to choose a destination, double-taps stars to fly, drags the ship onto stars, drags the time slider, double-taps empty space and orbits with two fingers; the campaign does not synthesise touches on hardware.
rows.pass: Touch-to-frame latency recorded for 200 samples per device; a tap (travel under 10 points, lifted within 0.5 s) on a star chooses it as the destination; a second tap on the same star within 0.35 s and 22 points flies there with the chosen wait while playing; a ship drag (16 points or more from the ship) previews the star under the finger and sends exactly one route.fly on release over a star joined by a corridor; a slider drag sets the wait under the finger; a double tap on empty space restores the authored orbit.
rows.procedure: Tap stars to choose destinations, double-tap a star to fly, drag the ship onto a star, drag the time slider, orbit the camera with two fingers and double-tap empty space on each device; the campaign records the interval from touch to the first frame showing the change.
rows.title: Touch feel and touch-to-frame latency

rows.pass: The sound is audible only while it is on, the panel is shown and the scene is active, and follows the silent switch; each planned haptic is felt (where the device has no haptic engine, the haptic part is recorded as not applicable).
rows.procedure: Turn the Sound toggle on and play a level to a win and to a failure with the haptics switch on, including one refused action (flying to a star no corridor joins, which the rules refuse); choose a destination to hear its audition; observe the firmament's ambient sound and the selection, success, warning and error haptics.
